question: Should QQBot gateway sockets enforce the proposed 1 MiB inbound limit, or use a more conservative fixed ceiling such as 16 MiB?
rationale: The dependency terminates connections above maxPayload, while the available QQBot protocol material does not establish a maximum legitimate gateway event size; selecting the cutoff therefore requires channel-owner intent rather than code review alone.

options.title: Use conservative 16 MiB
options.body: Match the merged Discord gateway hardening precedent while still reducing the ws default from 100 MiB.

options.title: Keep 1 MiB
options.body: Retain the tighter boundary if QQBot owners can confirm realistic message, member, and lifecycle events cannot exceed it.

options.title: Pause for protocol evidence
options.body: Defer the change until an authoritative limit or representative production-sized event establishes a defensible ceiling.

recommendation.title: Use conservative 16 MiB
recommendation.body: Match the merged Discord gateway hardening precedent while still reducing the ws default from 100 MiB.

likelyOwner.reason: Their QQBot gateway architecture work is the strongest history signal for determining the channel’s legitimate event-size requirements.
